title: Common Data Curation Schema
description: Unified schema for curated code examples across all task branches

task.description: The task type this example belongs to

input.description: Input for the task (e.g., function signature, buggy code)

output.description: Expected output for the task (e.g., function body, fixed code)

function_name.description: Name of the function (for code generation tasks)

line_start.description: Starting line number in source file

line_end.description: Ending line number in source file

has_docstring.description: Whether the example includes a docstring
